descriptionFull: The least sandpiper ( Calidris minutilla ) is the smallest shorebird. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris , a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific minutilla is Medieval Latin for "very small".
